description: Includes v10 retained OCR evidence and v11 optional extraction-v2 sources, structured values, name associations, explicit roleEvidence, authorizationEvidence, sourceCorrectionEvidence, tablePartyEvidence, company lookup provenance and bounded private region OCR receipts. Explicit migrations 037/038/039 are required; 033 remains reserved. Document-only privacy-v5 is opt-in and preserves complete source words in NER windows with conservative masking of known entities in partial native text; readers retain privacy-v1/v2/v3/v4/v5 history, sourceCoverage, scoped NER positions and fragmentOf provenance. Assistant and extraction-v1 retain privacy-v2. Before new writes, retain a SHA-bound rollback build from this code with all five privacy readers, optional role/authorization/source-correction/table-party proof readers and adoption reconstruction, and dispatch fences, while new extraction, lookup, region OCR and source-span dispatch are disabled. Version 11 alone does not establish rollback compatibility. Disabling source-span dispatch blocks unfinished v3/v4/v5 calls while retaining history; it does not promise seamless continuation. Local source proofs remain candidates requiring explicit Maker adoption and independent source groups. OCR clues do not establish a completed visual signature review. Additive migration 040 stores immutable document price and usage-upper-bound receipts; old reservations and unknown calls are preserved. Pricing dispatch is opt-in. Compatible rollback disables document dispatch and retains the new accounting tables; it must never delete or reprice old receipts. Version 12 retains deterministic-v3 rule packages, derived review details and pending-material snapshots, and enforces company/personal source-region ownership and stale-object guards. Version 11 must not resume these workflows or accept new facts after activation. No historical SQL migration is changed. Rollback must target a previously activated version-12 release carrying these readers and guards; retain the exact validated release and never lower the floor. Version 13 pins case-level public/synthetic processing approvals in document jobs and rechecks their scope, policy, expiry and independent authority before dispatch and writes. Migration 041 is required. Rollback must retain version-13 grant readers and fences, disable P3_DOCUMENT_CASE_AUTHORIZATION_ENABLED on API and Worker, and preserve approval/audit history. Never lower the authorization floor or resume a pinned grant under static authorization. Version 14 requires migration 042, retains withdrawn requests and distinguishes legacy case-read approval authority from scoped request-only approval authority. Rollback must retain both authority readers and dispatch fences in a version-14 build, disable API/Worker case authorization, preserve history and never lower the floor. Version 15 requires migration 043 and readers for privacy-v6, immutable document recovery history and the recovery-aware same-job dispatch fence. Older workers must never resume recovered jobs or validate new privacy-v6 snapshots. Before enabling new processing, retain a SHA-bound, actually activated version-15 rollback build with these readers and guards. Emergency rollback disables document processing and its dependent dispatch features on both API and Worker while keeping source readers and approval history; it does not restore old authorization or retry unknown calls. Preserve all original model receipts, recovery attempts and failure audits; never lower the compatibility floor or remove migration 043. Chinese reference translation adds 044_document_translation.sql after the existing unique migration sequence; the unshipped translation migration was renumbered without changing SQL bytes. Existing deployed SQL and ledger entries remain immutable. The version-15 rollback 17cf3eb37ee8e787797a941a9610aaa04960875c claims only the four previously supported document job kinds and cannot claim translate_document. Before rollback, disable P3_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATION_ENABLED on both API and Worker; retain all translation snapshots, segments and unknown-call receipts. Historical translations become temporarily unavailable in the older UI and must never be retried or removed as part of rollback. Returning to this release rechecks source, identity and ledger fences. Version 16 is the deployed line-word-source-v1 / engine-4 source-assembly reader boundary; retain immutable regions, word/line links, source uncertainty and legacy parses. It does not require the independent review-round migrations. Version 17 is the V2 round and delivery boundary: require full filenames 042_review_rounds.sql, 043_case_pre_review_closure.sql, 045_review_delivery.sql, 046_review_analysis.sql and 047_reference_translation_permission.sql alongside existing processing/translation migrations. Numeric prefixes are not ledger identities. Version 18 adds independent Checker decisions, frozen submissions, purpose-bound formal jobs and Worker-only settlement; require unchanged 048_checker_review.sql, 049_checker_termination.sql, 050_formal_review.sql and 051_formal_review_history.sql. Versions 15/16/17 must not resume this database. Before enabling writes, actually activate and retain a SHA-bound version-18 read-only rollback with all readers and authority fences; it blocks business mutations and Worker dispatch, preserves every historical/unknown receipt, and never lowers the floor or restores the production database automatically. Real model acceptance is deferred by the user; this release does not enable or authorize formal cloud dispatch. Version 19 adds immutable manual signature-information records (052_signature_information.sql), evidence-bound authorization/date/position checks, review invalidation and mandatory Checker snapshot validation. Older v18 releases must not accept decisions while unaware of these obligations. Before opening writes, activate and retain a SHA-bound v19 read-only rollback with identical readers and fences. Never lower the floor, delete signature history or enable vision/formal cloud dispatch as part of this release. Version 20 adds automatic round file-list membership, atomic file removals and frozen materialScope=file-list snapshots including unresolved files. No new SQL migration. Older v19 readers and writers must not reinterpret new file-list snapshots or resume review jobs. Before enabling writes, actually activate and retain a SHA-bound v20 read-only rollback with identical file-list readers and Worker fences. Never lower the compatibility floor, delete original files/history or re-run model calls as part of rollback. Version 21 introduces immutable Maker declarations for reuse of the unified public/synthetic document processing policy. New document jobs pin kind=policy, declaration ID, policy hash and configuration release. Retain declaration/revocation readers and recheck current policy, Maker authority, material registration and pinned references before dispatch and result writes. No new SQL migration. Before opening writes, actually activate and retain a SHA-bound v21 read-only rollback with identical readers and fences; it blocks business mutations and all Worker dispatch. Older v20 releases must not interpret policy jobs or resume processing. Never lower the authorization floor, reinterpret policy jobs as static or case-approved grants, delete declarations/history, retry unknown calls or restore the production database as application rollback. Version 22 adds system-derived Demo processing permits (kind=demo_policy) pinned to the policy ID/version/hash and published configuration. P3_DOCUMENT_POLICY_REUSE_ENABLED now applies this Demo policy automatically to registered synthetic PDFs. Keep legacy policy/case/static readers and never change the authority source of an existing job. The system audit event document:demo_policy_applied is required for every new Demo job. Automatic reconciliation admits only never-started current-round materials under the original uploader authority; restored, unknown and already-started jobs are never recreated. No SQL migration. API/Worker/Web must deploy together with a version-22 read-only rollback; older version-21 code must not resume this database. Preserve historical declarations and all model receipts. Version 23 requires 053_case_numbers.sql and 054_required_independent_review.sql. New cases allocate immutable transactional case numbers and require a verified original attachment. Active cases require an independent current Checker confirmation for ordinary closure; explicit unreviewed termination preserves its own receipt. Never infer confirmation for historical closures or reinterpret old receipts. Before opening writes, activate and retain an identical version-23 read-only rollback that retains all readers and blocks every business mutation and Worker dispatch. Older v22 writers must not resume this database; never lower the floor, renumber historical migrations, retry unknown model calls or automatically restore production. Version 24 requires 054_round_result_confirmation.sql through 059_checker_worker_fence.sql alongside 054_required_independent_review.sql. Draft rounds may carry execution snapshots; submitted rounds await independent Checker confirmation. Checker correction ownership is bound to round, person and assignment version; its contributions remain distinguishable from Maker contributions. Before opening writes, activate and retain a version-24 read-only build of this same code, with all business mutations and Worker dispatch blocked. Older v23 applications cannot resume the new states; never lower the compatibility floor or restore production as application rollback. Version 25 requires 060_fixed_review_teams.sql and preserves standing administrator-authorized Maker/Checker pairings, case-scoped auto-visibility, and revocation guards during creation. Retain an activated v25 read-only rollback build before opening writes; v24 does not enforce configured automatic assignment. Version 26 retains document privacy-v7 source projections and repair-v7 private-call reuse alongside v1-v6 readers and existing recovery fences. Only an exact literal newline escape in source-span document vocabulary is layout, while larger entities and inbound output validation stay protected. Before new writes, activate and retain a version-26 read-only rollback build of this code with v7 readers and backup verification. Older v25 releases must not resume v7 preparations; do not lower the floor, rewrite historical snapshots or retry unknown model calls. No new SQL migration. Formal JPEG/PNG parsing adds jpg/png sourceFormat in document scopes. Rollback readers and backup validators must retain these formats and original-image hash binding before accepting new image parse writes; the existing authorization version alone does not prove image compatibility. No historical artifacts are rewritten. DOCX automatic processing now uses the same demo_policy permit as PDF/JPEG/PNG. Rollback readers and backup validators must accept registered docx jobs with that permit and preserve their source anchors and audit binding; existing policy/case/static task scopes are not widened. Before rolling back to a build without this support, stop document dispatch and retain a same-reader read-only rollback. No SQL migration or historical receipt rewrite. Version 27 retains document privacy-v8 source projections: source-span document preparation leaves the fixed document vocabulary of role words, form boxes and joining words readable, sets a label apart from a value read together with it at a layout gap, and treats a per-file dictionary made only of code-owned definitions as public; names, places, numbers and edited definitions stay masked, and the outbound rescan is unchanged. Recovery and repair-v7 reuse accept v8. Before new writes, activate and retain a version-27 read-only rollback build of this code with v8 readers and backup verification. Older v26 releases must not resume v8 preparations; do not lower the floor or rewrite historical snapshots.
